title: An open containing a limit image contains an eventual stage image
statement: Let J be a small cofiltered category, D:J\to Scheme a diagram [def-pc-scheme], c a limiting cone [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit], every D(j) quasi-compact and every transition affine [pqf-def-affine-morphism]. Fix j and an open U of D(j). If the inverse image of U along the projection c.pt\to D(j) is the whole scheme, then there are k and a:k\to j such that the inverse image of U along D(a) is the whole scheme. Quasi-separatedness of the stages and quasi-compactness of U are not required.

proof.text: Apply Mathlib AlgebraicGeometry.exists_map_eq_top to D,c,hc and U. It states exactly that a whole inverse image under a limit projection becomes whole under a single transition into the same stage. Its proof applies exists_mem_of_isClosed_of_nonempty to the compact closed complements of the inverse images, deriving a limit point outside U if all those complements are nonempty.
